exposure: bilateral common iliac artery (CIA) temporary clamping
cohort: 32 women who underwent cesarean-hysterectomy due to placenta percreta
finding: Bilateral CIA temporary clamping during cesarean-hysterectomy for placenta percreta significantly reduced blood loss and the need for blood transfusions.
mod_finding: This study found that bilateral common iliac artery (CIA) temporary clamping during cesarean-hysterectomy for placenta percreta reduced blood loss and blood transfusion rates.
